mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. about a design-build project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting us, consider defining your project goals, desired functions for the space, and an estimated budget range. Gathering inspiration photos, making a list of 'must-have' features, and having an idea of your preferred timeline can also be very helpful. This preparation allows our team to better understand your vision and provide a more accurate initial assessment, helping to streamline the early design discussions for homes in areas like Fremont or San Leandro.
